meta_description: Experience a revolutionary 20-minute full-body workout in Alentejo with EMS. Build strength, lose weight, and improve performance. Book your session today!
tech_p: Electro Muscle Stimulation (EMS) is a revolutionary full-body workout that uses safe, low-frequency electrical impulses to stimulate up to 90% of your muscles simultaneously. This method provides a high-intensity workout in just 20 minutes, making it an incredibly efficient and effective way to achieve your fitness goals.
benefit_card_1_p: Get the results of a 3-hour conventional workout in just 20 minutes.
benefit_card_2_p: Activates deep muscle fibers to increase strength and muscle mass effectively.
benefit_card_3_p: No weights, no high-impact movements. The perfect workout without stressing your joints.
benefit_card_4_p: Boosts your metabolism during and after the workout, helping to burn fat.
benefit_card_5_p: Improves posture and can help alleviate back pain by strengthening core muscles.
benefit_card_6_p: Enhances speed, power, and endurance for athletes and fitness enthusiasts.
about_us_p: We combine the expertise of our certified instructors with the latest in EMS technology to deliver a personalized, safe, and highly effective workout experience. Our team is dedicated to helping you achieve your fitness goals efficiently and with professional guidance every step of the way.
services_pack_1_week: 1 session per week: 345 euro (28.75 per session)
services_pack_2_week: 2 sessions per week: 660 euro (27.50 per session)
